purpose.description: The TFT OpenGPU Stack Module provides the hardware-accelerated compute layer for TriadicFrameworks' most intensive structural tensor operations. It wraps GPU-optimised implementations of the Dimensional Resonance Scanner's 66-pair coefficient computation, the Coherence Tensor Engine's N×N tensor decomposition, the Stability Basin Cartographer's basin scoring, and the Triadic Regime Synthesizer's domain translation passes. At scale (large regime graphs, multi-domain runs, continuous monitoring), OpenGPU reduces DRM generation time from O(N²) CPU time to near-real-time.
